prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one game ability VFX token atlas, 1024x1024 square RGBA with a truly transparent background. Exactly FOUR isolated hand-painted fantasy effect emblems in an exact evenly spaced 2 by 2 cell grid. Cell centers at 25% and 75% of image width/height. Keep each emblem entirely within the central 65% of its cell, with transparent gutters and no crossing between cells. No text, labels, frames, circles around icons, UI buttons, background, full characters, numbers, decorative borders, shadows or scenery. These are small rendered effect tokens and HUD icons; actual range shapes are rendered separately by the game. Strong distinct silhouette, detailed painted material, restrained glow, readable at 32px. Avoid large opaque panels. Depict characteristic tools/energy/material symbols, not a screenshot or miniature scene. Cell order: TOP LEFT passive, TOP RIGHT skill1, BOTTOM LEFT skill2, BOTTOM RIGHT ultimate. Original avatar: Coiljack Ampfist. Character visual motifs: stocky utility electrician with two folding traffic-bar gauntlets, spooled spring cable and safety visor; not an extending hook robot.
TOP LEFT: Impact Audit. Ability concept: when an enemy ends a dash within 110 GU, Coiljack gets one Inspection charge (max 2, 4 s lockout per enemy).
TOP RIGHT: Turnstile Bar. Ability concept: plants a 55-GU breakable spring bar for 3.5 s, showing one open half and one closed half. Walking enemies pass; the first **dash through the closed side** is diverted 20 GU to its safe edge and consumes the bar.
BOTTOM LEFT: Earth Clip. Ability concept: attaches a grounding clip to an ally for 2.5 s. The next displacement inflicted on that ally is reduced by 40% and the attacker is briefly revealed; no stun/knockup.
BOTTOM RIGHT: Inspection Grid. Ability concept: builds two intersecting turnstiles for 5 s. Enemies may walk around or smash either gate, but repeated aggressive dashes spend their movement on detours and trigger a 0.45 s disarm after the second interception.
